data.narrative:
Smack Technologies is a Series A defense & security company founded by former military operators (CEO Andy Markoff, ex-MARSOC and Palantir; COO Clint Alanis, 20+ years Marine special ops) that has raised $32M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 11 same-sector peers at Series A and Series B stages, including 8 private companies (Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Singularity, NODA AI, and others) and 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

Two methods are applicable here. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement to the $32M raised as a proxy baseline, implying a $64M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the 11-company comp set yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M (minimum) to $3.0B (maximum), reflecting the sector's broad valuation dispersion at this stage. The peer sample includes Dream Security at $3.0B (Series B), Allen Control Systems at $2.2B (Series B), and Harmattan AI at $1.4B (Series B).

Triangulation of these methods supports a valuation range of $54M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median estimate of $532M. The wide range reflects uncertainty around Smack's revenue traction, market position relative to better-capitalized peers, and the inherent volatility of Series A defense-tech valuations. Founder pedigree and stage of capital raise anchor the low end; peer multiples and sector growth potential inform the upper bound.
